dct_title_s: Plan showing the proposed arrangement and equipment of Sumner Field, Minneapolis, Minnesota
dct_description_sm: A plan showing the proposed arrangement and equipment of Sumner Field in Minneapolis, Minnesota. The plan is found in the Thirtieth Annual Report of the Board of Park Commissioners of the City of Minneapolis, after page 108.
